description: The Libraries, Audit, Settings, Data and Diagnostics tabs on a phone: Access Roles' dashboard page at 375x812 with touch (pointer: coarse) and jellyfin-web's mobile layout, as admin, reading only. On the Libraries, Audit, Settings, Data and Diagnostics tabs nothing is past the screen's right edge and the page doesn't scroll sideways, and every button, checkbox row, select and text field is at least 44 px tall; the probe's 81-character library name (one unbroken word after "Tabs probe ") wraps inside the screen, isolated, and so does its rename warning; the Audit filters are one column; the rule tables' headings are hidden. accessroles-admin-tabs-probe.mjs --webcheck runs it.

steps.name: the module mounted: the tabs, the status loaded, the chips, the loading note hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length === 8 && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesChips [data-chip]').length >= 10; })()

steps.name: the check's helpers
the measures
the mobile layout at 375 px, a coarse pointer
Libraries: past the right edge, and controls under 44 px
Libraries: it fits and every control is 44 px tall
the 81-character library name, wrapped inside the screen
steps.eval: (() => { const e = __arTabs.card("Tabs probe NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN").querySelector('.jfar-page-library-name'); const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return { right: Math.round(r.right), twoLines: r.height > parseFloat(getComputedStyle(e).lineHeight || getComputedStyle(e).fontSize) * 1.5, dir: !!e.querySelector('[dir="auto"], bdi') }; })()

steps.name: inside the screen, on more than one line, isolated
Audit: past the right edge, and controls under 44 px
Audit: it fits and every control is 44 px tall
the filters in one column
steps.assert: (() => { const cells = [...__arTabs.page().querySelector('.jfar-page-filters').children].map(e => e.getBoundingClientRect()); return cells.length >= 5 && cells.every(r => Math.round(r.left) === Math.round(cells[0].left)) && cells.every((r, i) => i === 0 || r.top >= cells[i - 1].bottom - 1); })()
